Name: Fallout Bighorner Goats
Author: Saberie
Description:
I love fallout, and after seeing some of the other Fallout related mods around here, I decided to make my own. This is a simple retexture sprite that replaces the adult goats and turns them into Bighorner goats from Fallout New Vegas. I do not know how Content Patcher works, so this is a simple .XNB file. I recommend you copy and save the original goat sprite before replacing it with this one, just in case you want to bring back the old normal goats back.


This mod does not require anything, simply extract the zip folder and drop the Animals folder into the Content folder, or just grab the .XNB file and drop it into the game's Animal folder. Steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content

Recommended mods to go with this one
